title: Duck Shrine
body:
Introduction

The Duck Shrine is a small cave with an underwater entrance. The shrine contains a pedestal of which to place an item, and two duck statues to either side. Before use, the Duck Shrine has a green glow with particles floating around the air nearby. The entrance is located to the right of the short arch bridge between the Taiga and the Grasslands in Finlay Island.

To access the entrance, players must swim through the water to the hole and emerge at the duck shrine. Players will need to bring the Baby Ducky along in order to receive the Adult Ducky.

Once used, the Duck Shrine's particles and glow will turn yellow. There is a cooldown, and it will last roughly a minute before it can be used again.

In order to exit with an Adult Ducky, players must swim across to the exit. There is a large hole on the Grasslands side of the bridge. Players will find a ladder to climb out.

Trivia

- The Pebble of Truth quest is linked to the shrine. - The Duck Shrine is connected to the Epic Duck event.

- There is a very large duck located at sea not far from the island of Pi.
